verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents its own SDKs: a Swift SDK, a Kotlin SDK, a React Native SDK (a JavaScript-ecosystem library), and 'six thin bindings' over one C++ core, so official client libraries do exist across languages. There is no evidence of an official Python library or a general JavaScript/Node library. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint relies on OpenAI's clients rather than RunAnywhere's own, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: an official Python client library, a documented JavaScript/Node (non-React Native) library, a named list of the six bindings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
